title: How Ships Evolved 🚢 From Hollow Logs to Mega Ships #shorts #engineering
description:
For thousands of years, open water was a wall. From a ten-thousand-year-old dugout canoe to Egyptian sails, ocean-crossing galleons, Fulton's 1807 steamboat, the first container ship in 1956, and today's giants carrying over 20,000 containers. Follow for more How It Evolved!
